header.title: InputSearch
header.description: Search field with a magnifying-glass icon and a clear control. Enter fires `onSearch` and Escape empties the field. Use Combobox when the query should pick from a list of options.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Try the main props and copy the generated code.
playground.label: Search
playground.helperText: Type, then use clear or Escape to empty the field.

base.title: Base
base.description: Magnifying glass at the start and a clear button when there is text. Escape also empties the field.

texts.label: Search
texts.helperText: Type, then use clear or Escape to empty the field.

withValue.title: With value
withValue.description: The clear button appears when the field has text.

texts.label: Search
texts.helperText: Clear appears when the field is not empty.

customIcon.title: Custom icon
customIcon.description: `prefixIcon` replaces the magnifying glass with another icon.

texts.label: Search
texts.helperText: Decorative suffix sits before the clear control.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `isDisabled` locks the field and hides the clear button.

error.title: Error
error.description: `errorMessage` marks the field as invalid and forces the error border.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three sizes: sm, md and lg.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: Drive the value with value, `onChange` and `onClear`. Enter fires `onSearch` with the current value.

tailwind.brandHelper: Secondary accent and pill shape with cn() on wrapperClassName.
tailwind.mergedHelper: radius-xs replaces radius-full thanks to tailwind-merge.

css.label: Branded search
css.helperText: No border, soft tertiary background and pill shape.

header.title: InputSearch API
header.description: API reference for the InputSearch React component: props, events, CSS classes, variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath to load only this component.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: InputSearch wraps InputText: it accepts all its props (except type) and native <input> attributes. className goes to the <input> and wrapperClassName to the container, which also gets the gem-input-search class.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.keyboard: Enter fires onSearch and Escape empties the field and fires onClear.
a11y.clear: The clear button has an aria-label (Clear by default, change it with clearLabel) and does not steal focus from the input.
a11y.label: helperText and errorMessage are linked with aria-describedby; the error uses role="alert".

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: InputSearch adds gem-input-search classes to the InputText ones.

rules.label: Field label.
rules.field: Container for the input, icons and button.
rules.suffix: Container for the suffix and the clear button.
rules.message: Helper or error text below the field.
rules.hasClear: Applied when the clear button is shown.
rules.suffixAndClear: Applied with both `suffixIcon` and the clear button.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: InputText variables the component computes by measuring the prefix and suffix, applied as inline style on the root. Read them from your CSS; a class cannot override them.

items.--gem-input-prefix-pad: Measured width of the magnifying glass or prefix icon; used as the input left padding.
items.--gem-input-suffix-pad: Measured width of the suffix and clear button; used as the input right padding.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: gem-system tokens used by the field. Redefine them in your `wrapperClassName` to change only this field.

items.--gem-shadow-focus: Focus ring of the input and clear button.
items.--gem-color-fg-muted: Placeholder, magnifying glass, clear button and helper text.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts InputText props (except type) and native <input> attributes.

items.clearable: Shows the clear button when there is text.
items.clearLabel: Accessible name of the clear button.
items.prefixIcon: Icon at the start. Magnifying glass by default; null hides it.
items.suffixIcon: Decorative icon before the clear button.
items.placeholder: Placeholder text when the field is empty.
items.label: Visible field label.
items.labelPlacement: Label position: above or on the border.
items.helperText: Hint below the field (hidden when `errorMessage` is shown).
items.errorMessage: Error copy. Marks the field as invalid.
items.infoText: Shows an info icon with this content.
items.infoLabel: Accessible name of the info icon.
items.border: Border tone. Forced to error when the field is invalid.
items.validRegex: Pattern the value must match. Failing values show the error border.
items.isDisabled: Disables the field and hides the clear button.
items.isRequired: Marks the field as required (aria-required + asterisk).
items.wrapperClassName: Extra classes for the root container.
items.onChange: Native event on every change. Also fires on clear, with an empty value.
items.onClear: Fires after the field is cleared (button or Escape).
items.onSearch: Receives the current value when Enter is pressed.
items.onValidate: Fires when validity changes based on `validRegex`.
items.onInfoClick: Fires when the info icon is activated.
